steps.name: b-1-bench-core
steps.verify: set -o pipefail && bash -n bin/delegate && python3 -m py_compile lib/*.py && [ -f tests/test_bench_core.sh ] && for f in tests/test_*.sh; do l=/tmp/gate-$(basename "$f" .sh).log; env -u DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR bash "$f" >"$l" 2>&1 || { echo "GATE FAIL $f"; grep -h FAIL "$l" | head -20; exit 1; }; done && for fn in run_worker run_worker_docker run_worker_native ensure_network ensure_egress ensure_task_egress host_args read_mount_args make_guard_shims; do cmp -s <(git show bench:bin/delegate | sed -n "/^$fn() {/,/^}/p") <(sed -n "/^$fn() {/,/^}/p" bin/delegate) || { echo "CAGE CHANGED $fn (R19: orchestrator code)"; exit 1; }; done && { git diff --quiet bench -- lib/grants.py worker/egress.Dockerfile worker/egress-entrypoint.sh worker/entrypoint.sh lib/render-opencode-config.py worker/agent-launch || { echo "CAGE CHANGED files (R19: orchestrator code)"; exit 1; }; } && ! git diff --name-only bench | grep -qvE '^docs/specs/b-|^bin/delegate$|^lib/bench\.py$|^lib/ledger\.py$|^tests/test_ledger\.sh$|^tests/test_bench_core\.sh$' && echo GATE-OK
